summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market purchases of 7,000,000 ordinary shares on 7 July 2026 at a volume-weighted average price of 114.8604 pence per share (range 114.30–115.55 pence). The purchases were executed by Goldman Sachs International under an existing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The Company intends to cancel the repurchased shares, reducing outstanding equity. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated. This is a routine capital return via share buyback and cancellation, not tied to any control transaction. Watch for continued execution under the programme and potential updates to total repurchase authorisation.
